rawRun.scope: Actual host scaling, both homepage themes, two requested sizes and three page zooms. Records initial and settled navigation computed colors, opacity, disabled states and active CSS transitions; verifies native keyboard settings return and persisted draft on normal restart. Captures are taken after the navigation reaches its existing inherited body color. Physical input, complete homepage controls, other pages/displays and full visual acceptance remain separate.

finding: The completed DOM suite and normal close do not establish homepage screenshot acceptance. Individual inspection of the first two light wide captures shows the previously closed settings dialog still in the native compositor capture; the third is a homepage. The fixture did not wait for paint after modal dismissal. Adopt the existing double-requestAnimationFrame capture pattern before BrowserWindow.capturePage, retain this evidence and rerun. Separately recorded initial and settled computed navigation colors/active color transitions support a transient theme-transition explanation for this unchanged candidate, without diagnosing unrelated faults.
